paragraphs.title: Samuel's Death and the Introduction of Nabal and Abigail

easy.explanation: Samuel was buried in his house at Ramah.
easy.q: Where was Samuel buried?

easy.explanation: David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
easy.q: Where did David go after Samuel died?

answers: A woman of good understanding and beautiful countenance
easy.explanation: Abigail was wise and beautiful, unlike her harsh husband.
easy.q: How is Abigail described?

answers: Nabal was harsh, while Abigail was wise
Nabal was poor, while Abigail was rich
Nabal was a shepherd, while Abigail was a soldier
medium.explanation: Nabal was churlish and evil in his doings, while Abigail had good understanding.
medium.q: What was the main difference between Nabal and Abigail?

answers: He was very wealthy and had many animals
He lived alone in the wilderness
medium.explanation: Nabal had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats.
medium.q: What does the description of Nabal show about his possessions?

medium.explanation: Nabal is described as harsh and evil in his conduct.
medium.q: What does the word “churlish” mean in this passage?

answers: Nabal dies, Samuel is buried, and David goes to Carmel
Samuel dies and is buried, David goes to the wilderness, and Nabal and Abigail are introduced
Abigail meets David, and then Samuel dies
challenge.explanation: This is the order of events in the opening verses.
challenge.q: Which sequence appears at the beginning of the chapter?

answers: It emphasizes the contrast between her wisdom and Nabal's harshness
It shows that both were warriors
It proves that Nabal was Abigail's first husband
challenge.explanation: The contrast in their characters explains Abigail's wise action later.
challenge.q: Why is Abigail's introduction important to the rest of the story?

answers: He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats
challenge.explanation: The large number of animals demonstrates Nabal's wealth.
challenge.q: Which detail shows Nabal's wealth?

easy.explanation: David sent ten young men.
easy.q: How many young men did David send to Nabal?

easy.explanation: Nabal was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
easy.q: What was Nabal doing when David sent the request?

easy.explanation: David asked Nabal to give whatever came to his hand to his servants and David.
easy.q: What did David ask Nabal to give?

answers: They had been protected and had suffered no harm
He wanted them to join his army
He wanted to take their sheep
medium.explanation: David said that his men had not hurt the shepherds and that nothing was missing.
medium.q: Why did David mention Nabal's shepherds?

answers: He mocked David and refused to give anything
medium.explanation: Nabal asked who David was and refused to share his provisions.
medium.q: How did Nabal respond to David's request?

answers: Nothing was lacking or lost for them
medium.explanation: The phrase means that the shepherds suffered no loss or harm.
medium.q: What does the phrase “neither was there ought missing unto them” mean?

answers: His men had protected Nabal's shepherds and had not harmed them
He wanted to test Nabal's wealth
challenge.explanation: David appealed to the protection his men had provided.
challenge.q: What reason did David give for asking for a gift?

answers: He asked, “Who is David?” and “Who is the son of Jesse?”
challenge.explanation: Nabal spoke as though David were unworthy of consideration.
challenge.q: Which detail in Nabal's answer shows his contempt for David?

answers: Nabal gave them a large gift
They understood that the request had been refused
challenge.explanation: They returned to David and reported Nabal's words.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from the young men's return after Nabal finished speaking?

paragraphs.title: Preparation for Revenge and the Servant's Warning

easy.explanation: David told every man to gird on his sword.
easy.q: What did David command his men to do?

easy.explanation: Four hundred men went with David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.
easy.q: How many men went up after David?

easy.explanation: A servant of Nabal told Abigail about the danger.
easy.q: Who warned Abigail?

answers: David and his men were coming to punish the household
The shepherds wanted to leave Carmel
medium.explanation: The servant said that evil was determined against Nabal and his household.
medium.q: Why was the servant afraid of what Nabal's refusal would cause?

answers: As enemies who harmed the shepherds
As good men who protected them
As strangers who did not know the area
medium.explanation: The men had been good to the shepherds and had kept them safe.
medium.q: How did the servant describe David's men?

medium.explanation: The servant compared David's men to a wall of protection by night and day.
medium.q: What does the phrase “They were a wall unto us” mean?

answers: He believed she could act wisely
challenge.explanation: The servant appealed to Abigail because she could respond wisely to the danger.
challenge.q: Why did the servant speak specifically to Abigail?

answers: David protected the shepherds, while Nabal answered with contempt
Both men tried to avoid meeting
Nabal protected the shepherds, while David harmed them
challenge.explanation: The servant describes David's kindness and Nabal's unreasonable conduct.
challenge.q: What contrast between David and Nabal is emphasized?

answers: Nabal's refusal leads David to prepare for revenge
Samuel's death leads to David's marriage
Abigail's arrival leads to the sheep being sheared
challenge.explanation: After Nabal refused David, David prepared to attack him.
challenge.q: What cause-and-effect relationship appears in these verses?

paragraphs.title: Abigail's Action and Meeting with David

answers: A gift of food and drink
easy.explanation: She prepared bread, wine, sheep, grain, raisins, and figs.
easy.q: What did Abigail prepare for David and his men?

easy.explanation: Abigail placed the provisions on donkeys.
easy.q: What animals carried Abigail's gift?

answers: She dismounted and bowed before him
easy.explanation: She hastened off the donkey and fell before David.
easy.q: What did Abigail do when she saw David?

answers: She prepared a gift and sent her servants ahead
She asked Nabal to go before her
medium.explanation: She quickly prepared the provisions and told her servants to go ahead.
medium.q: What did Abigail do before going to meet David?

answers: He was drunk and it was not a suitable time to speak to him
She planned to join David secretly
medium.explanation: Nabal was feasting and was very drunk.
medium.q: Why did Abigail not tell Nabal that she was leaving?

answers: He was coming down the road with his men
He was sitting at the feast
He had already returned to the wilderness
medium.explanation: David and his men came down against her, and she met them.
medium.q: Where was David when Abigail met him?

answers: She hurried, prepared a gift, and sent her servants ahead
She waited for Nabal to awaken
She asked David to return the next day
challenge.explanation: Her rapid preparations were intended to reach David before he attacked.
challenge.q: Which detail emphasizes the urgency of Abigail's action?

answers: She intended to stop him before he reached Nabal's house
She wanted David to attack immediately
She did not know why David had come
challenge.explanation: Meeting him on the road gave her an opportunity to speak before the attack.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from Abigail meeting David on the road?

answers: She met David, prepared food, and sent servants
She prepared a gift, sent servants ahead, and went to meet David
She spoke to Nabal, left, and then prepared the gift
challenge.explanation: This is the order recorded in the passage.
challenge.q: Which sequence correctly describes Abigail's actions?

paragraphs.title: Abigail's Speech and Appeal for Forgiveness

easy.explanation: Abigail asked David not to shed blood or avenge himself.
easy.q: What did Abigail ask David to do?

easy.explanation: She described Nabal as a man of Belial whose name reflected his folly.
easy.q: Whom did Abigail blame for the offense?

answers: The LORD would appoint him ruler over Israel
He would become a shepherd at Carmel
easy.explanation: She said that the LORD would establish David as ruler over Israel.
easy.q: What did Abigail say about David's future?

answers: She took the blame upon herself and reminded him of his future
She hid the gift from him
She asked Nabal to go to war
medium.explanation: She asked David to bear her trespass and warned him against avenging himself.
medium.q: How did Abigail try to prevent David from shedding blood?

answers: Give it to the young men who followed him
medium.explanation: She asked that the blessing be given to the young men following David.
medium.q: What did Abigail ask David to do with the gift she brought?

answers: A deed that would bring David sorrow or trouble
medium.explanation: Abigail warned that needless bloodshed could become a burden to David's conscience.
medium.q: What does “no grief” or “offence of heart” suggest in Abigail's speech?

answers: A leader who fights the LORD's battles and avoids evil
A man who seeks wealth at any cost
A man who will never rule
challenge.explanation: She reminded him that he fought the LORD's battles and had no evil in him.
challenge.q: What image of David did Abigail seek to strengthen?

answers: To persuade him to leave judgment in the LORD's hands
To urge him to begin the battle immediately
To show that Nabal was stronger than David
challenge.explanation: She pointed David toward the LORD's judgment rather than personal revenge.
challenge.q: Why did Abigail mention that the souls of David's enemies would be slung out?

answers: Revenge could cause him to shed blood causelessly and later trouble his conscience
He would run out of food
challenge.explanation: She warned that needless bloodshed could become grief and an offense to David.
challenge.q: What central danger did Abigail present to David?

paragraphs.title: David Accepts Abigail's Counsel and Nabal's Death

easy.explanation: David blessed the LORD God of Israel.
easy.q: Whom did David bless because Abigail had been sent to him?

easy.explanation: David acknowledged that Abigail had kept him from shedding blood.
easy.q: What did David do after hearing Abigail's words?

answers: The LORD smote him, and he died
easy.explanation: The LORD smote Nabal, and Nabal died.
easy.q: What happened to Nabal about ten days later?

answers: She kept him from shedding blood
medium.explanation: David said that her counsel had prevented him from avenging himself.
medium.q: Why did David thank Abigail?

answers: He sent for Abigail to take her as his wife
He sent men to avenge Nabal
medium.explanation: David sent and communed with Abigail in order to take her as his wife.
medium.q: What did David do after hearing that Nabal had died?

answers: He was struck with fear and became unresponsive
medium.explanation: The description shows that Nabal collapsed into a stone-like state before his death.
medium.q: What does the phrase “his heart died within him, and he became as a stone” mean?

answers: He moves from revenge to accepting Abigail's counsel and avoiding bloodshed
He moves from forgiveness to attack
He leaves Carmel to join Saul
challenge.explanation: David begins intending revenge but changes after hearing Abigail.
challenge.q: What change takes place in David during this episode?

answers: He saw it as the LORD returning Nabal's wickedness upon him
He thought Abigail had killed Nabal
He did not know Nabal had died
challenge.explanation: David declared that the LORD had returned Nabal's wickedness upon his own head.
challenge.q: How did David understand Nabal's death?

answers: Nabal was drunk, so she waited until the wine had gone out of him
challenge.explanation: She told him nothing while he was very drunk, but spoke when he was sober in the morning.
challenge.q: Why did Abigail wait until morning to tell Nabal what had happened?

easy.explanation: David's servants came to Abigail with his message.
easy.q: Who asked Abigail to become David's wife?

easy.explanation: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel as his wife.
easy.q: Who was David's other wife mentioned in these verses?

easy.explanation: Saul gave Michal to Phalti son of Laish.
easy.q: To whom did Saul give Michal?

answers: She agreed humbly and went with David's messengers
She refused and returned to Nabal
medium.explanation: Abigail bowed herself and went after David's messengers.
medium.q: How did Abigail respond to the marriage proposal?

answers: She offered to be a servant who washed the feet of David's servants
medium.explanation: Abigail called herself a handmaid and servant.
medium.q: Which action expresses Abigail's humility?

answers: They describe David's marriages and Michal's transfer to another man
They describe David's journeys in the wilderness
medium.explanation: The verses summarize David's wives and Saul's giving of Michal to Phalti.
medium.q: What is the connection among the references to Abigail, Ahinoam, and Michal?

answers: She accepted the proposal and agreed to become David's wife
She intended to return to Nabal
challenge.explanation: The passage says that she went with the messengers and became David's wife.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from Abigail's going after David's messengers?

answers: She changed from Nabal's wife to David's wife
She changed from shepherd to queen
She changed from maiden to servant
challenge.explanation: After Nabal's death, David took Abigail as his wife.
challenge.q: What change in Abigail's position is described?

answers: David takes Abigail, while Saul gives Michal to Phalti
Saul asks David to protect Nabal
challenge.explanation: The passage places David's marriage to Abigail beside Saul's transfer of Michal.
challenge.q: Which detail at the end creates a contrast between David and Saul?
